AZURE.azure_policy: Secure transfer to storage accounts should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Plain HTTP requests expose data and shared keys to interception in transit.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable secure transfer (supportsHttpsTrafficOnly: true) so the account only accepts HTTPS requests.

AZURE.azure_policy: Storage account public access should be disallowed
AZURE.risk: Anonymous containers let anyone on the internet list and read blob data.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable anonymous public blob access (allowBlobPublicAccess: false) on the account.

AZURE.azure_policy: Storage accounts should have the specified minimum TLS version
AZURE.risk: Legacy TLS 1.0/1.1 protocols have known weaknesses that allow downgrade and decryption attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or later (minimumTlsVersion: 'TLS1_2').

AZURE.azure_policy: Storage accounts should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: A storage endpoint reachable from any network widens the attack surface for credential stuffing and data exfiltration.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access and set networkAcls defaultAction to 'Deny'; reach the account through a private endpoint or selected virtual networks, allowing trusted Microsoft services.

AZURE.azure_policy: Storage accounts should use customer-managed key for encryption
AZURE.risk: Without controlled encryption at rest, compromised media or backups could expose data.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep storage service encryption (SSE) for encryption at rest enabled; use customer-managed keys in Key Vault when regulation requires key custody.

AZURE.azure_policy: Storage accounts should prevent shared key access
AZURE.risk: Account keys grant full, non-attributable access and are frequently leaked in code and config.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable shared key authorization (allowSharedKeyAccess: false) and use Microsoft Entra ID with RBAC for data access.

AZURE.azure_policy: Soft delete should be enabled for blobs and containers
AZURE.risk: Accidental or malicious deletion becomes unrecoverable.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable blob and container soft delete with a retention period of at least 7 days.

AZURE.azure_policy: Key vaults should have deletion protection enabled
AZURE.risk: An attacker or mistake could permanently destroy keys, making encrypted data unrecoverable.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable purge protection (enablePurgeProtection: true) so deleted vaults and secrets cannot be permanently purged during the retention period.

AZURE.azure_policy: Key vaults should have soft delete enabled
AZURE.risk: Deleted secrets, keys and certificates cannot be recovered.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep soft delete enabled with softDeleteRetentionInDays set (90 recommended).

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Key Vault should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: A vault reachable from the public internet is exposed to brute-force and token replay attempts.
AZURE.recommendation: Restrict the vault to private networks: publicNetworkAccess 'Disabled' with a private link endpoint, or networkAcls defaultAction 'Deny' with trusted service bypass.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Key Vault should use RBAC permission model
AZURE.risk: Access policies are coarse-grained and bypass central RBAC governance and PIM.
AZURE.recommendation: Use the Azure RBAC permission model (enableRbacAuthorization: true) instead of vault access policies.

AZURE.azure_policy: Resource logs in Key Vault should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Secret access cannot be investigated after an incident.
AZURE.recommendation: Send AuditEvent logs to a Log Analytics workspace through diagnostic settings.

AZURE.azure_policy: Key Vault secrets should have an expiration date
AZURE.risk: Long-lived secrets increase the blast radius of a leak.
AZURE.recommendation: Set expiration dates on secrets and keys and rotate them before expiry.

AZURE.azure_policy: App Service apps should only be accessible over HTTPS
AZURE.risk: Traffic over plain HTTP can be intercepted or modified.
AZURE.recommendation: Set httpsOnly: true so HTTP requests are redirected to HTTPS.

AZURE.azure_policy: App Service apps should use the latest TLS version
AZURE.risk: Older TLS versions are vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or later (siteConfig.minTlsVersion: '1.2').

AZURE.azure_policy: App Service apps should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Internal workloads exposed to the internet invite scanning and exploitation.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access for internal apps and front them with a private endpoint, Application Gateway or Front Door.

AZURE.azure_policy: App Service apps should use managed identity
AZURE.risk: Embedded credentials leak through app settings, logs and source control.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable a managed identity and use it to reach Key Vault, Storage and databases instead of connection strings.

AZURE.azure_policy: FTPS only should be required in App Service apps
AZURE.risk: FTP sends deployment credentials in clear text.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable FTP deployment (siteConfig.ftpsState: 'Disabled' or 'FtpsOnly').

AZURE.azure_policy: App Service apps should have remote debugging turned off
AZURE.risk: Remote debugging opens additional inbound ports on the worker.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep remote debugging disabled outside of short troubleshooting windows.

AZURE.azure_policy: Function apps should only be accessible over HTTPS
AZURE.risk: Function triggers over HTTP expose payloads and function keys.
AZURE.recommendation: Set httpsOnly: true on the function app.

AZURE.azure_policy: Function apps should use the latest TLS version
AZURE.risk: Older TLS versions are vulnerable to protocol downgrade attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Require TLS 1.2 or later (siteConfig.minTlsVersion: '1.2').

AZURE.azure_policy: Function apps should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Publicly reachable function endpoints can be invoked or abused by anyone holding a leaked key.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access for internal functions and integrate the app with a virtual network.

AZURE.azure_policy: Function apps should use managed identity
AZURE.risk: Storage account keys in app settings grant full account access if leaked.
AZURE.recommendation: Use a managed identity for the AzureWebJobsStorage connection and downstream services (identity-based connections).

AZURE.azure_policy: Public network access on Azure SQL Database should be disabled
AZURE.risk: Internet-exposed SQL endpoints are continuously targeted by password spraying.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access (publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled') and connect through a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure SQL Database should have Microsoft Entra-only authentication enabled
AZURE.risk: SQL logins are shared secrets that bypass MFA and conditional access.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Entra-only authentication and use managed identities for applications.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure SQL Database should be running TLS version 1.2 or newer
AZURE.risk: Older TLS versions are vulnerable to downgrade attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Set minimalTlsVersion to '1.2'.

AZURE.azure_policy: Auditing on SQL server should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Database access and schema changes cannot be traced.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable server auditing to a Log Analytics workspace or storage account.

AZURE.azure_policy: Transparent Data Encryption on SQL databases should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Database files and backups could be read if storage media is compromised.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep Transparent Data Encryption enabled for encryption at rest.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure SQL Managed Instances should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: The public endpoint exposes the instance to internet-based attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep the public data endpoint disabled and connect over the virtual network or a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure SQL Managed Instance should have Microsoft Entra-only authentication enabled
AZURE.risk: SQL logins are shared secrets that bypass MFA.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Entra-only authentication.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Cosmos DB should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Internet-reachable accounts are exposed to key abuse and data exfiltration.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access (publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled') and use a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Cosmos DB database accounts should have local authentication methods disabled
AZURE.risk: Primary keys grant full, non-attributable access to all data.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable key-based auth (disableLocalAuth: true) and use Entra ID with Cosmos DB data-plane RBAC.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Cosmos DB accounts should use continuous backup
AZURE.risk: Periodic backups may lose hours of data after corruption or deletion.
AZURE.recommendation: Use continuous backup mode for point-in-time restore.

AZURE.azure_policy: Public network access should be disabled for PostgreSQL flexible servers
AZURE.risk: Publicly reachable database servers are exposed to credential attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Deploy with private access (VNet integration) or disable public network access and use a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Enforce SSL connection should be enabled for PostgreSQL flexible servers
AZURE.risk: Unencrypted database connections leak credentials and query data.
AZURE.recommendation: Require secure transport (require_secure_transport = ON) with TLS 1.2 or later.

AZURE.azure_policy: PostgreSQL flexible servers should use Microsoft Entra authentication
AZURE.risk: Password-only authentication cannot enforce MFA or central revocation.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable Microsoft Entra authentication and prefer managed identities for applications.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Database for PostgreSQL single server is retired
AZURE.risk: Single server is retired and no longer receives security updates.
AZURE.recommendation: Migrate single-server deployments to Azure Database for PostgreSQL flexible server.

AZURE.azure_policy: Public network access should be disabled for MySQL flexible servers
AZURE.risk: Publicly reachable database servers are exposed to credential attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Deploy with private access (VNet integration) or disable public network access and use a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: MySQL servers should enforce TLS 1.2
AZURE.risk: Unencrypted database connections leak credentials and query data.
AZURE.recommendation: Require secure transport and set tls_version to TLSv1.2 or later.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Database for MySQL single server is retired
AZURE.risk: Single server is retired and no longer receives security updates.
AZURE.recommendation: Migrate single-server deployments to Azure Database for MySQL flexible server.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure AI Services resources should restrict network access
AZURE.risk: Model endpoints reachable from the internet can be abused for data exfiltration and cost attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access (publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled') and use a private endpoint, or set networkAcls defaultAction 'Deny'.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure AI Services resources should have key access disabled
AZURE.risk: API keys are long-lived shared secrets and are frequently leaked.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable local (key) authentication (disableLocalAuth: true) and use Microsoft Entra ID.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure OpenAI resources should restrict network access
AZURE.risk: Publicly reachable model endpoints can be abused with leaked keys.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access (publicNetworkAccess: 'Disabled') and reach the endpoint through a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure OpenAI resources should have key access disabled
AZURE.risk: API keys bypass identity-based access control and auditing.
AZURE.recommendation: Set disableLocalAuth: true and grant applications the 'Cognitive Services OpenAI User' role through managed identity.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure AI Foundry hubs and projects should use private link
AZURE.risk: Model, data and prompt traffic is exposed on public endpoints.
AZURE.recommendation: Configure the hub with a managed virtual network (isolation mode) and private endpoints.

AZURE.azure_policy: Resource logs in Azure AI services should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Prompt abuse and data access cannot be investigated.
AZURE.recommendation: Send audit and request logs to a Log Analytics workspace.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Machine Learning workspaces should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Workspace APIs and datastores are exposed to the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access and use private endpoints with a managed virtual network.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Machine Learning computes should have local authentication disabled
AZURE.risk: Local credentials on compute bypass central identity controls.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable local authentication on compute and use Microsoft Entra ID.

AZURE.azure_policy: Management ports should be closed on your virtual machines
AZURE.risk: Exposed management ports are brute-forced within minutes of deployment.
AZURE.recommendation: Do not expose RDP (3389) or SSH (22) to the internet; use Azure Bastion or just-in-time VM access.

AZURE.azure_policy: Virtual machines should enable encryption at host
AZURE.risk: Temporary disks and caches could hold unencrypted data.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable encryption at host so temp disks and caches are encrypted at rest.

AZURE.azure_policy: Machines should be configured to periodically check for missing system updates
AZURE.risk: Unpatched operating systems are the most common path to compromise.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable Azure Update Manager periodic assessment and automatic guest patching.

AZURE.azure_policy: Virtual machines should use managed identity
AZURE.risk: Credentials stored on disk can be harvested after a compromise.
AZURE.recommendation: Assign a managed identity instead of storing credentials on the machine.

AZURE.azure_policy: Endpoint protection should be installed on your machines
AZURE.risk: Malware and intrusions go undetected.
AZURE.recommendation: Onboard machines to Microsoft Defender for Servers or an equivalent EDR solution.

AZURE.azure_policy: Virtual machine scale sets should have automatic OS upgrades enabled
AZURE.risk: Instances drift out of patch compliance.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable automatic OS image upgrades and health probes.

AZURE.azure_policy: Management ports should be closed on virtual machine scale sets
AZURE.risk: Exposed management ports are brute-forced.
AZURE.recommendation: Do not expose RDP or SSH on the scale set load balancer; use Azure Bastion.

AZURE.azure_policy: Managed disks should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Disk export SAS URLs can be generated and downloaded from anywhere.
AZURE.recommendation: Set publicNetworkAccess 'Disabled' and networkAccessPolicy 'DenyAll' or 'AllowPrivate'.

AZURE.azure_policy: Managed disks should be double encrypted with platform-managed and customer-managed keys
AZURE.risk: Platform-managed keys may not meet regulatory key-custody requirements.
AZURE.recommendation: Use a disk encryption set with customer-managed keys when regulation requires key custody.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Batch accounts should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Batch account endpoints are exposed to the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access and use private endpoints.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Batch accounts should disable local authentication
AZURE.risk: Shared keys grant full account access.
AZURE.recommendation: Allow only Microsoft Entra authentication (allowedAuthenticationModes: ['AAD']).

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Kubernetes Service private clusters should be enabled
AZURE.risk: A public API server is exposed to credential and vulnerability attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Use a private cluster, or restrict the API server with authorized IP ranges.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Kubernetes Service clusters should have local authentication methods disabled
AZURE.risk: Static cluster-admin certificates cannot be revoked individually.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable local accounts (disableLocalAccounts: true) and enable Microsoft Entra integration with Azure RBAC.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Policy Add-on for Kubernetes service should be installed and enabled
AZURE.risk: Privileged or misconfigured pods can compromise the node.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable the Azure Policy add-on and apply the pod security baseline.

AZURE.azure_policy: Kubernetes clusters should use network policies
AZURE.risk: Flat pod networking allows lateral movement after a pod compromise.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable a network policy engine (Azure, Calico or Cilium) and default-deny namespace traffic.

AZURE.azure_policy: Kubernetes Services should be upgraded to a non-vulnerable Kubernetes version
AZURE.risk: Clusters on unsupported versions miss security fixes.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable an automatic upgrade channel ('patch' or 'stable') and node OS auto-upgrade.

AZURE.azure_policy: Container registries should not allow unrestricted network access
AZURE.risk: Images and pull tokens are exposed to the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access on Premium registries and use private endpoints.

AZURE.azure_policy: Container registries should have the admin user disabled
AZURE.risk: The admin user is a shared credential with push and pull rights.
AZURE.recommendation: Set adminUserEnabled: false and pull with managed identity (AcrPull role).

AZURE.azure_policy: Container registries should have anonymous authentication disabled
AZURE.risk: Anyone can pull proprietary images.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep anonymous pull disabled (anonymousPullEnabled: false).

AZURE.azure_policy: Network security groups should not allow inbound management traffic from the internet
AZURE.risk: Open management ports are brute-forced continuously.
AZURE.recommendation: Deny inbound RDP (3389) and SSH (22) from 'Internet' or '*' sources.

AZURE.azure_policy: All network ports should be restricted on network security groups
AZURE.risk: Overly permissive rules expose services that were meant to be internal.
AZURE.recommendation: Avoid 'Any' source rules; scope inbound rules to specific ports and source prefixes.

AZURE.azure_policy: Flow logs should be configured for every virtual network
AZURE.risk: Network-level investigations lack evidence.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable virtual network flow logs with traffic analytics.

AZURE.azure_policy: Subnets should be associated with a network security group
AZURE.risk: Subnets without an NSG allow unfiltered lateral traffic.
AZURE.recommendation: Associate a network security group with every workload subnet.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure DDoS Protection should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Volumetric attacks can take public endpoints offline.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable DDoS Network Protection for virtual networks that host internet-facing workloads.

AZURE.azure_policy: Subnets should be private
AZURE.risk: Implicit outbound IPs make egress hard to control and audit.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable default outbound access (defaultOutboundAccess: false) and use NAT Gateway or a firewall for egress.

AZURE.azure_policy: Network interfaces should not have public IPs
AZURE.risk: Directly exposed VMs bypass centralized perimeter controls.
AZURE.recommendation: Do not attach public IP addresses directly to NICs; publish through a load balancer, gateway or Bastion.

AZURE.azure_policy: Public IP addresses should have resource logs enabled for Azure DDoS Protection
AZURE.risk: Basic SKU public IPs are retired and lack DDoS telemetry.
AZURE.recommendation: Use Standard SKU public IPs, zone-redundant where available, protected by DDoS Network Protection.

AZURE.azure_policy: Web Application Firewall (WAF) should be enabled for Application Gateway
AZURE.risk: Web apps are exposed to OWASP Top 10 attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Use the WAF_v2 SKU with a WAF policy in Prevention mode.

AZURE.azure_policy: Application Gateway should use a TLS policy that requires TLS 1.2
AZURE.risk: Weak ciphers allow downgrade and decryption attacks.
AZURE.recommendation: Use a predefined TLS policy of AppGwSslPolicy20220101 or newer.

AZURE.azure_policy: Load balancers should use the Standard SKU
AZURE.risk: Basic SKU is retired and lacks secure-by-default behaviour.
AZURE.recommendation: Use the Standard SKU; Basic load balancers are retired.

AZURE.azure_policy: DNS zones should be protected against deletion
AZURE.risk: Accidental deletion causes outages and enables subdomain takeover.
AZURE.recommendation: Apply a CanNotDelete resource lock to production DNS zones.

AZURE.azure_policy: API Management services should use a virtual network
AZURE.risk: Backend APIs are exposed without a perimeter.
AZURE.recommendation: Deploy in internal VNet mode or disable public network access, publishing through Application Gateway with WAF.

AZURE.azure_policy: API Management should disable insecure protocols and ciphers
AZURE.risk: Legacy protocols allow interception.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable TLS 1.0/1.1, SSL 3.0 and 3DES in customProperties.

AZURE.azure_policy: API Management secret named values should be stored in Azure Key Vault
AZURE.risk: Secrets stored inline in APIM are hard to rotate and audit.
AZURE.recommendation: Use Key Vault-backed named values accessed through managed identity.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Service Bus namespaces should have local authentication methods disabled
AZURE.risk: SAS keys are shared secrets with broad rights.
AZURE.recommendation: Set disableLocalAuth: true and use Entra ID RBAC (Azure Service Bus Data Sender/Receiver).

AZURE.azure_policy: Service Bus namespaces should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Messaging endpoints are exposed to the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access on Premium namespaces and use private endpoints.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Data Factory should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Pipelines and linked services are reachable from the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access and use a managed virtual network with managed private endpoints.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Data Factory linked services should use Key Vault for storing secrets
AZURE.risk: Inline secrets in linked services leak through exports.
AZURE.recommendation: Reference credentials from Key Vault or use managed identity authentication.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Databricks workspaces should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Workspace and cluster endpoints are exposed publicly.
AZURE.recommendation: Use VNet injection with secure cluster connectivity (no public IP) and private link.

AZURE.azure_policy: Logic Apps should use managed identity for connections
AZURE.risk: Connection secrets and run history can expose credentials.
AZURE.recommendation: Authenticate connectors and HTTP actions with managed identity; secure trigger inputs and outputs.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Cache for Redis should only allow secure connections
AZURE.risk: Cache data and access keys travel unencrypted.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable the non-SSL port (enableNonSslPort: false) and require TLS 1.2.

AZURE.azure_policy: Azure Cache for Redis should disable public network access
AZURE.risk: Cache endpoints are exposed to the internet.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable public network access and use a private endpoint.

AZURE.azure_policy: Automation accounts should use managed identity
AZURE.risk: Certificates and variables can leak credentials.
AZURE.recommendation: Use a managed identity instead of Run As accounts; encrypt variables.

AZURE.azure_policy: Application Insights components should block non-Entra ID based ingestion
AZURE.risk: Anyone with the connection string can inject fake telemetry.
AZURE.recommendation: Disable local authentication (DisableLocalAuth: true) so telemetry ingestion requires Entra ID.

AZURE.azure_policy: Application Insights components should be workspace-based
AZURE.risk: Classic components are retired and cannot be governed centrally.
AZURE.recommendation: Link the component to a Log Analytics workspace (WorkspaceResourceId).

AZURE.azure_policy: Activity log should be retained for at least one year
AZURE.risk: Control-plane changes cannot be investigated after the default 90 days.
AZURE.recommendation: Export the subscription activity log to a Log Analytics workspace with adequate retention.

AZURE.azure_policy: Accounts with owner permissions on Azure resources should be MFA enabled
AZURE.risk: Password-only accounts are easily phished or sprayed.
AZURE.recommendation: Require multi-factor authentication for all users through Conditional Access.

AZURE.azure_policy: Conditional Access should block legacy authentication
AZURE.risk: Legacy protocols cannot enforce MFA.
AZURE.recommendation: Block legacy authentication protocols tenant-wide.

AZURE.azure_policy: Privileged roles should use just-in-time access
AZURE.risk: Standing privileged access increases the impact of a compromised account.
AZURE.recommendation: Use Privileged Identity Management for eligible, time-bound role activation.

AZURE.azure_policy: A maximum of 3 owners should be designated for your subscription
AZURE.risk: Too many owners widens the privileged attack surface.
AZURE.recommendation: Keep subscription owners to a small, reviewed group (between 2 and 3).

AZURE.azure_policy: Guest accounts with owner permissions on Azure resources should be removed
AZURE.risk: External identities are outside your lifecycle and MFA controls.
AZURE.recommendation: Remove guest and external accounts from privileged roles and review access regularly.

AZURE.azure_policy: Custom subscription owner roles should not exist
AZURE.risk: Custom wildcard roles silently grant owner-equivalent rights.
AZURE.recommendation: Prefer built-in least-privilege roles; avoid wildcard custom roles.

AZURE.azure_policy: Subscriptions should have a contact email address for security issues
AZURE.risk: Security alerts go unnoticed.
AZURE.recommendation: Configure security contact details and alert notifications in Defender for Cloud.

AZURE.azure_policy: Require a tag on resources
AZURE.risk: Untagged resources cannot be attributed, costed or cleaned up.
AZURE.recommendation: Enforce tags such as environment, owner and cost-center with Azure Policy.

AZURE.azure_policy: Allowed locations
AZURE.risk: Data residency obligations can be breached.
AZURE.recommendation: Restrict deployments to approved regions with Azure Policy.

AZURE.azure_policy: Microsoft Defender for Cloud plans should be enabled
AZURE.risk: Threats and misconfigurations are not detected.
AZURE.recommendation: Enable Defender CSPM and the workload plans (Servers, Storage, Key Vault, Databases, Containers) that match your estate.

AZURE.azure_policy: Microsoft cloud security benchmark initiative should be assigned
AZURE.risk: Continuous compliance drift goes unmeasured.
AZURE.recommendation: Assign the Microsoft cloud security benchmark policy initiative at management group scope.

AZURE.azure_policy: Resource providers should be registered deliberately
AZURE.risk: Unreviewed preview features may not meet security and support requirements.
AZURE.recommendation: Register only the resource providers you need and review preview features before enabling them.
